FIJ reports that VitalReg is the digital birth registration recently launched by Nigeria's National Population Commission, where a Lagos man found a birth registered in February under his name.

The Federal Ministry of Information reports Akwa Ibom State announced commencement of the electronic civil registration and vital statistics (e-CRVS) system for digital registration of births and deaths, replicating the NPC chairman's 15 July 2026 national briefing, with NPC asking the state to support full roll-out.

The article says Barnksforte Technologies Limited supports the development and deployment of the electronic civil registration and vital statistics system, with UNICEF providing technical, financial and technological support.
system: electronic civil registration and vital statistics system

fact: The NPC says its digitization includes mobile devices for real-time birth data collection, particularly in remote areas.

The NPC release says the First Lady's initiative supports birth registration using the national e-CRVS in all health facilities and communities, with symbolic electronic registration of children at the launch, where registrations were previously manual.
The NPC chairman said the e-CRVS system integrates birth registration with health facilities across several states, with over 15,000 children registered in Jigawa alone.

President Tinubu launched the VitalReg electronic civil registration and vital statistics system on 8 November 2023, implemented by the National Population Commission under a public-private partnership with Barnksforte Technologies and UNICEF support; no offices or coverage are stated.
